# Christopher Bogart and David Perla interviewed on "Legally Speaking Podcast"


June 9, 2025


-
-
-
-


CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) and Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) are interviewed on the *Legally Speaking Podcast* , where they discuss Burford’s leadership at the forefront of legal finance, their career journeys and passion for innovation.


Listen below or on[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UL3oD0NDeAM) ,[Apple Podcasts](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/building-a-%247-5b-legal-finance-powerhouse-with/id1485892170?i=1000712028372) and[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/3HtJpFriQ0JGEbpil6U6P1?si=89eeaf5e84f24055) ).
